name: tradehand
description: Find and book local UK tradespeople at fixed prices.

interface.longDescription: Find UK tradespeople by trade and area, see their services and fixed prices, get an instant quote, and book a visit. When you approve the price, Tradehand books the slot with the trader and gives you a secure Stripe link to pay.
